_doc: Variant = changes on top of a scenario. Keys: model (all agents), backend, advisor (true | {name, model, effort, for}), agents (count or list), agent_overrides ({index-or-name: {model, role, focus, ...}}), defaults ([defaults] keys, e.g. max_turns_per_hour, effort), toml (deep-merged into the generated crew.toml, for new crew flags).
